Critical mineral supply chain pressures trigger intense corporate lobbying. 🇨🇦

### Mining & Metals
Glencore has boosted in-house critical mineral lobbying expenditures as major trading houses scale up strategic engagement to navigate shifting international trade policies and resource security. This increased scrutiny on supply chain transparency and permitting reform demands proactive policy alignment, prompting advisory practices to structure specialized support around regulatory compliance and government affairs.

### Technology & Manufacturing
TSMC is actively seeking rare-earth-free factory equipment as strict export controls create cascading operational risks for downstream manufacturing hubs globally. Advanced manufacturers must audit equipment dependencies, requiring industrial engineering partners to deliver alternative component sourcing strategies and risk-mitigation frameworks for factory upgrades.

### Exploration & Resources
Koryx Copper S.A. (TSXV:KRY) lifted 3.59% following fresh funding and drill intercepts at the Haib project, reinforcing Namibia's position as a secure jurisdiction for energy transition minerals. Expanding these resource estimates requires advanced geological modeling and rigorous metallurgical testing to support upcoming feasibility studies and capital allocation frameworks.

### Artificial Intelligence & Geosciences
The Embassy of Liberia has engaged [KoBold Metals](https://www.koboldmetals.com/) to advance geoscientific research and responsible mineral exploration using artificial intelligence to modernize historical archives. Technology providers should offer digital site solutions and data modernization services to support sovereign geological surveys and AI-driven exploration pipelines.
